'''2012 Bespin Regionals Morgan Dwyer DS Combat Readiness''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Morgan Dwyer]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness|Endor-D-combatreadiness.gif|label=Combat Readiness / Full Scale Alert}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
